name: Cuyahoga County, OH
findings: Cuyahoga County has 6,781 nonprofit organizations. 2,445 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,972 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Cuyahoga County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
